Note to the team: I'll check the return status now.

Hi Kevin, and sorry for getting your name wrong earlier.

No, it hasn't reached us yet, and I can see why the tracking didn't work. The number I sent you is not the one the carrier is actually scanning. The live number on your return is (number hidden). It went out as UPS Ground Saver, which hands the parcel to USPS for the last leg, so that number tracks on usps.com rather than UPS.

The return shows as Awaiting Arrival at our Chattanooga, Tennessee warehouse, which is normal for a Ground Saver drop-off on the 20th. Ground Saver is the slow service, so it usually takes the better part of a week to get there and scan in.

Nothing more is needed from you. The moment it is checked in I will write to you here with the confirmation, and the settlement we discussed is applied off the back of that check-in, so it doesn't depend on you chasing it.

On your question about the store credit expiring, I don't want to give you a half answer on that one. A colleague picks that up tomorrow at 10am Eastern and the answer comes straight to this thread.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
